prompts.name: attach_current_workspace
prompts.title: Attach current workspace
prompts.description: Attach the current folder to Mission Control and report the safest next step.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Attached project or orchestration ID, attach mode, and a compact safe status summary.
prompts.safety_notes: Prefer read-only import posture for existing codebases and do not expose secrets.
prompts.prompt_text: Attach the current workspace to Mission Control. Reuse an existing project or orchestration if safe. If the folder looks like an existing codebase, prefer read-only first behavior. Summarize the attach result and the safest next step in compact markdown.

prompts.name: use_mission_control_for_repo
prompts.title: Use Mission Control for this repo
prompts.description: Start a manager-led Mission Control workflow for the current repo from Codex chat.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Compact status, pending decisions if any, and a clear statement that Mission Control owns orchestration.
prompts.safety_notes: Codex is the bridge, not the manager. Do not bypass approvals.
prompts.prompt_text: Use Mission Control for this repo. Attach the workspace, start the requested manager-led task, summarize status, and surface pending decisions if Mission Control needs user input. Do not act like the manager yourself.

prompts.name: import_existing_codebase
prompts.title: Import existing codebase
prompts.description: Attach an existing repo or folder to Mission Control with a read-only scan and understanding pass first.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Codebase map summary, understanding summary, interview choice request, and safe next step.
prompts.safety_notes: Do not run write-capable steps until Mission Control and the user allow them.
prompts.prompt_text: Import this existing codebase into Mission Control. Attach it in read-only-first mode, retrieve the codebase map and understanding summary, ask for the interview mode if needed, then start the requested task through Mission Control.

prompts.name: start_manager_led_task
prompts.title: Start Manager-led task
prompts.description: Start a Mission Control task for an already attached project and return compact status.
prompts.expected_chat_output: New or reused orchestration state plus any user-blocking decisions.
prompts.safety_notes: Respect existing pending decisions instead of replacing them with a new local plan.
prompts.prompt_text: Start a Mission Control manager-led task for the attached project. Return compact status and surface any pending decisions immediately if the orchestration is waiting on the user.

prompts.name: continue_orchestration
prompts.title: Continue orchestration
prompts.description: Check the current orchestration, summarize progress, and stop at pending user decisions when necessary.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Progress summary, blockers, active agents, and pending decisions if present.
prompts.safety_notes: Poll only when useful and do not confuse waiting with completion.
prompts.prompt_text: Continue the Mission Control orchestration by checking status, a safe event digest, and pending decisions. If the run is blocked on the user, present that cleanly and stop there. If it is active, summarize progress in compact markdown.

prompts.name: show_pending_approvals
prompts.title: Show pending approvals
prompts.description: Load the current pending decisions and present the top user-facing approval or question cleanly.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Top pending decision with risk, reason, and choice options.
prompts.safety_notes: Do not answer the decision until the user explicitly chooses an option.
prompts.prompt_text: Show the current pending approvals or manager questions from Mission Control. Render the highest-priority decision in compact markdown with risk, reason, and options.

prompts.name: answer_pending_approval
prompts.title: Answer pending approval
prompts.description: Send the user's selected answer back to Mission Control and confirm the result.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Confirmation that the decision was recorded and updated pending-decision state.
prompts.safety_notes: Preserve exact user intent, especially for one-time versus project-wide approvals.
prompts.prompt_text: Answer the pending Mission Control decision with the user's chosen option, then confirm the updated decision state without implying that any blocked action already ran.

prompts.name: review_latest_handoff
prompts.title: Review latest handoff
prompts.description: Retrieve the latest Mission Control handoff and summarize it for Codex chat.
prompts.expected_chat_output: What changed, how to run it, validation posture, limitations, and next steps.
prompts.safety_notes: Warn if the handoff is dry-run or missing evidence.
prompts.prompt_text: Review the latest Mission Control handoff and summarize what changed, how to run it, what validation exists, what limitations remain, and what next steps are recommended.

prompts.name: debug_failed_orchestration
prompts.title: Debug failed orchestration
prompts.description: Collect the minimum safe context needed to explain a stuck or failed Mission Control run, including device-aware diagnostics.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Concise blocker explanation, detected device family, safe debug commands, support-bundle path when available, and safe recovery options.
prompts.safety_notes: Do not expose raw logs or secrets by default.
prompts.prompt_text: Debug the failed or stuck Mission Control orchestration by collecting status, diagnostics, pending decisions, and a safe event digest. Include platform-aware diagnostics, performance guardrails, safe debug commands, and the latest support-bundle path when available. If needed, create a recovery plan request and summarize the safest next moves.

prompts.name: use_webwright_for_browser_task
prompts.title: Use Webwright for browser task
prompts.description: Check Webwright readiness for the attached project and route a browser task through Mission Control with explicit setup guidance if the runtime is missing.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Webwright readiness, install/setup blockers if any, and compact orchestration status for the browser task.
prompts.safety_notes: Prefer Webwright for multi-step browser work when it is actually installed. If it is missing, say so plainly and do not fake browser coverage.
prompts.prompt_text: Use Mission Control for a browser task with Webwright when available. First load the project-scoped Webwright readiness summary. If Webwright is not ready, explain the exact missing runtime pieces and the safe install steps. If it is ready, start the requested browser task through Mission Control and summarize the current status without pretending Codex chat is the browser agent itself.

prompts.name: pause_orchestration
prompts.title: Pause orchestration
prompts.description: Pause the active Mission Control orchestration and confirm the new state.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Confirmation that the orchestration is paused and what remains pending.
prompts.safety_notes: Pausing is a state change. Confirm the right orchestration before doing it.
prompts.prompt_text: Pause the specified Mission Control orchestration and then confirm the paused state with a compact status summary.

prompts.name: resume_orchestration
prompts.title: Resume orchestration
prompts.description: Resume a paused Mission Control orchestration after the user confirms it should continue.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Confirmation that the orchestration resumed or a clear explanation of what still blocks it.
prompts.safety_notes: Do not auto-resume a found orchestration without the user asking.
prompts.prompt_text: Resume the specified Mission Control orchestration if the user asked to continue, then summarize the updated state and any remaining pending decisions.

prompts.name: explain_current_swarm
prompts.title: Explain current swarm
prompts.description: Explain the active or proposed Mission Control swarm plan in compact Codex chat language.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Current swarm mode, size, risks, bottlenecks, and approval posture.
prompts.safety_notes: Do not invent a swarm plan if Mission Control has not produced one.
prompts.prompt_text: Explain the current Mission Control swarm plan. Keep it short, include mode, size, risks, dynamic spawning state, and whether any approval gates apply.

prompts.name: switch_swarm_strategy
prompts.title: Switch swarm strategy
prompts.description: Request a change to swarm strategy and summarize the updated plan or approval requirement.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Updated swarm preferences and the revised or pending-approval plan summary.
prompts.safety_notes: Respect Mission Control approval thresholds for larger or riskier swarms.
prompts.prompt_text: Switch the Mission Control swarm strategy according to the user's request, regenerate or refresh the plan if needed, and summarize the updated plan with any approval implications.

prompts.name: enable_safe_mode
prompts.title: Enable safe mode
prompts.description: Tighten project safety settings for a cautious Mission Control run.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Which safety settings were tightened and what remains approval-gated.
prompts.safety_notes: Never claim safe mode is active unless the policy updates succeeded.
prompts.prompt_text: Enable Mission Control safe mode for this project by tightening approvals, preserving read-only import posture, pausing dynamic spawning when supported, and restricting risky tools. Then summarize the resulting safety posture.

prompts.name: generate_agents_md_proposal
prompts.title: Generate AGENTS.md proposal
prompts.description: Produce a chat-friendly AGENTS.md proposal from Mission Control's codebase understanding.
prompts.expected_chat_output: AGENTS.md status, recommended path, proposal summary, and proposed sections.
prompts.safety_notes: Ask before writing or replacing AGENTS.md.
prompts.prompt_text: Generate an AGENTS.md proposal through Mission Control. Use the codebase map and AGENTS.md status, then present the proposal in Codex chat and ask the user whether to accept or revise it.

prompts.name: install_from_github
prompts.title: Install from GitHub
prompts.description: Bootstrap Mission Control headlessly from the GitHub repo, then report what is ready in Codex chat.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Install status, daemon/MCP readiness, ready runners, and any user actions still required.
prompts.safety_notes: Do not ask the user to open the standalone Mission Control UI. Never expose secrets or force API billing.
prompts.prompt_text: Install Mission Control from GitHub in headless mode, configure the daemon and MCP bridge, run plugin health, and summarize exactly what is ready and what still needs user action in Codex chat.

prompts.name: autowire_providers
prompts.title: Autowire providers
prompts.description: Probe safe local runners and provider config, then summarize ready and degraded runner paths.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Ready runners, degraded runners, unavailable runners, and specific user setup steps if any remain.
prompts.safety_notes: Local-first. Do not silently use billed API providers or persist secrets in chat-visible output.
prompts.prompt_text: Autowire all safely available Mission Control runners and providers, prefer local runners first, and report exactly which providers are ready, degraded, unavailable, or require explicit user setup.

prompts.name: ask_manager_for_plan
prompts.title: Ask Manager for plan
prompts.description: Request a fresh Mission Control manager plan without replacing the manager with Codex chat logic.
prompts.expected_chat_output: Compact status plus the latest manager plan posture or plan-blocking decision.
prompts.safety_notes: Use Mission Control as the planner. Do not invent the plan locally in Codex chat.
prompts.prompt_text: Ask Mission Control Manager for a plan for this project. Route the request through Mission Control, summarize the returned status and plan posture, and surface any pending decisions instead of improvising the plan in chat.

prompts.name: review_integration_catalog
prompts.title: Review integration catalog
prompts.description: Load the full cross-host integration catalog so Codex can summarize which Mission Control families are ready, imported, or still pretending.
prompts.expected_chat_output: A compact summary of ready families, missing host imports, and the most useful next connection or validation lanes.
prompts.safety_notes: Summarize normalized status and blockers. Do not expose raw credentials or pretend a detected CLI is the same thing as a working remote integration.
prompts.prompt_text: Review the Mission Control cross-host integration catalog and normalized connection registry. Summarize which integration families are already usable, which are host-imported only, which still need setup, and the highest-signal next fixes.

prompts.name: import_host_integrations
prompts.title: Import host integrations
prompts.description: Import Codex or Claude-discovered integration metadata into Mission Control before the operator starts guessing what is connected.
prompts.expected_chat_output: A compact import summary showing what was discovered from host assets and what still needs native Mission Control setup.
prompts.safety_notes: Report imported metadata and blockers only. Never claim host credentials were copied or verified unless the backend actually proved it.
prompts.prompt_text: Import integration metadata from any detected Codex or Claude host assets into Mission Control. Then summarize what was discovered, what became connected or host-imported, and which high-value families still need real setup.

prompts.name: review_project_integrations
prompts.title: Review project integrations
prompts.description: Load the project-scoped integration report when the operator needs the whole integration posture in one pass.
prompts.expected_chat_output: A compact project integration summary covering ready families, blockers, safe commands, and the next best connection or validation moves.
prompts.safety_notes: Keep the output project-scoped and evidence-based. Do not treat a detected config file as proof that the live provider is actually usable.
prompts.prompt_text: Review the project-scoped Mission Control integrations report. Summarize the ready families, the blocked or partial ones, the safest next commands, and the biggest gaps that still limit this project's integration posture.

prompts.name: review_project_integration_family
prompts.title: Review project integration family
prompts.description: Load one project-scoped integration family lane for focused review of status, actions, blockers, and safe commands.
prompts.expected_chat_output: A focused summary of one integration family, its readiness, safe commands, approval-relevant actions, and setup gaps.
prompts.safety_notes: Keep the output scoped to the requested family and do not oversell host-imported metadata as a verified live connection.
prompts.prompt_text: Review one project-scoped Mission Control integration family. Summarize its current status, imported host hints, safe commands, available actions, blockers, and the highest-signal next fix if the lane is still partial.

prompts.name: review_project_capabilities
prompts.title: Review project capabilities
prompts.description: Load the full project capability report when the operator needs the whole Mission Control execution and readiness picture in one pass.
prompts.expected_chat_output: A compact capability summary covering execution profiles, semantic impact, security, validation, swarm, runner, browser, and repo drift lanes.
prompts.safety_notes: Summarize the report instead of dumping every field blindly, and do not treat one healthy lane as proof that the whole project is healthy.
prompts.prompt_text: Review the full Mission Control capability report for the attached project. Summarize the strongest ready lanes, the partial or blocked lanes, the safest next commands, and the highest-signal gaps that still limit execution quality.

prompts.name: review_project_capability_section
prompts.title: Review project capability section
prompts.description: Load one named capability-report section so Codex can focus on a single Mission Control lane without dragging the other fourteen around.
prompts.expected_chat_output: A focused summary of one capability area, its status, safe commands, evidence, and any setup or drift gaps.
prompts.safety_notes: Keep the output scoped to the requested capability section and do not pretend the section proves unrelated parts of the system are healthy.
prompts.prompt_text: Review one named Mission Control capability-report section for the attached project. Load only the requested section, summarize its current status, safe commands, artifacts, and setup gaps, and explain what still limits that lane if anything remains partial.
